name: Cisco Systems, Inc.
summary:
Cisco Systems (CSCO) reported earnings of $1.22 per share on revenue of $17.25 billion for the fiscal fourth quarter ended July 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $1.17 per share on revenue of $16.85 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $1.20 per share. The company beat expectations by 1.67% while revenue grew 17.58% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it expects first quarter non-GAAP earnings of $1.32 to $1.34 per share on revenue of $18.0 billion to $18.20 billion. The current consensus earnings estimate is $1.15 per share on revenue of $16.77 billion for the quarter ending October 31, 2026. The company said it expects fiscal 2027 non-GAAP earnings of $5.05 to $5.11 per share on revenue of $72.20 billion to $73.40 billion. The current consensus earnings estimate is $4.83 per share on revenue of $67.75 billion for the year ending July 31, 2027.

"We delivered a very strong close to fiscal 2026, marking another record year for Cisco. Our record performance is a testament to the accelerated pace of innovation and the excellent execution by our teams," said Chuck Robbins, Chair and CEO of Cisco. "With the breadth and depth of our portfolio and our competitive differentiation in secure networking, Cisco is well positioned to support our customers however or wherever they decide to deploy AI."

Cisco Systems Inc is engaged in designing, manufacturing and selling of Internet Protocol (IP) based networking products and services related to the communications and information technology (IT) industry.
subject: Cisco Systems Beat Expectations

name: Cerebras Systems, Inc.
summary:
Cerebras Systems (CBRS) reported a loss of $0.04 per share on revenue of $180.11 million for the second quarter ended June 2026. The consensus estimate was a loss of $0.21 per share on revenue of $194.16 million. The Earnings Whisper number was a loss of $0.16 per share. The company beat expectations by 75.00%.

The company said it expects third-quarter revenue of $214.0 million to $216.0 million and 2026 revenue of $880.0 million to $890.0 million. The company's previous guidance was 2026 revenue of $855.0 million to $865.0 million. The current consensus revenue estimate is $206.68 million for the quarter ending September 30, 2026, and revenue of $865.31 million for the year ending December 31, 2026.

“This was an outstanding quarter for Cerebras. Core revenue more than doubled to $210 million, and our cloud business nearly quadrupled year-over-year,” said Andrew Feldman, Cerebras co-founder and CEO. “Speed changes what AI can do. It makes AI more useful, more productive, and opens entirely new markets. As a result, the demand for fast inference is enormous and Cerebras is scaling to meet it, securing more data center capacity, expanding manufacturing, and growing with customers and partners including OpenAI, AWS, AMD, and CrowdStrike.”

Cerebras Systems is building the fastest AI infrastructure in the world. We are a team of pioneering computer architects, computer scientists, AI researchers, and engineers of all types.
subject: Cerebras Systems Beat Expectations

name: Coherent Corp.

The consensus earnings estimate was $1.62 per share on revenue of $1.99 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $1.72 per share. The company beat expectations by 1.16% while revenue grew 33.75% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it expects first quarter non-GAAP earnings of $1.85 to $2.05 per share on revenue of $2.20 billion to $2.40 billion. The current consensus earnings estimate is $1.70 per share on revenue of $2.15 billion for the quarter ending September 30, 2026.

“Fiscal 2026 was an outstanding year for Coherent, with record revenue, significant margin expansion, and non-GAAP EPS growth that was more than twice the rate of revenue growth” said Jim Anderson, CEO. “We enter fiscal 2027 with exceptional customer demand, expanding production capacity, and multiple new growth platforms beginning to ramp. As AI datacenter architectures increasingly transition from copper to optical connectivity, we believe Coherent’s broad photonic technology portfolio and manufacturing scale uniquely position us to deliver accelerating growth and capitalize on this multi-year opportunity.”

Coherent empowers market innovators to define the future through breakthrough technologies, from materials to systems.
subject: Coherent Beat Expectations
